The following events took place in '''45 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*Loss of the [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]].
*[[Byss/Legends|Byss]] is first charted by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
*The [[Landor system/Legends|Landor system]] is overrun by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
*[[Toong'l/Legends|Toong'l]] is devastated by a pair of [[Comet/Legends|comets]] that strike its surface.<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] hosts a [[Gathering (Sojourn)|Gathering]] on [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]].<ref name="DPN">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
